rapport_notes: Excellent, natural rapport built over a long call — genuine humor and back-and-forth banter (wife's clothes, pedicure joke, piano joke) that never felt forced.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'do you have just some type of mind, concerns or questions that I can answer just write out the gate?' — asked immediately, before any logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concerns about valuable artwork and a heavy TV; rep asked how many pieces, their dimensions and weight, and directly addressed the insurance question over several turns rather than one pass.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'you only pay for the time used... if you use three to four hours, that's all you'll pay for anyway' (beats-it-pay-less).

top_strength: Built exceptional rapport through natural, warm banter while still handling a legitimate high-value insurance question (artwork the customer admitted was likely worth over $2,000) honestly rather than glossing over the coverage limit — a real trust-builder.
coaching_note: On-Time Guarantee and the communication/Meet-Your-Mover pieces were never mentioned in a 22-minute call that had plenty of room for them — given how much rapport was already built, weaving these in during the 'few reminders' moment would have been low-risk and easy.
